title: 0046 간편 플래너 웹판 저장소 — 설계 초안 · 사진 · 내 모듈은 서버만, 고친 차례는 하나씩, 버린 설계 · 사진 내용은 그대로, 지우기 없음(내 모듈만), 비공개 사진 버킷 (scripts/rls-probe.mjs --migration database/migrations/0046_planner_drafts.sql)
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'expert', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, 'partner', 'probe Y', 'agent', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, {{y_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active')

INSERT INTO public.planner_drafts (company_id, id, name, item, model, created_by, updated_by) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'd-probe-a', '거실장', 'sink', '{"format":"dadam.planner-lite/1","walls":[]}'::jsonb, {{x_owner_user}}, {{x_owner_user}})
INSERT INTO public.planner_drafts (company_id, id, model, created_by, discarded_at) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'd-probe-gone', '{"walls":[]}'::jsonb, {{x_owner_user}}, now())

INSERT INTO public.planner_draft_photos (company_id, draft_id, file, mime, bytes, sha256, created_by) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'd-probe-a', 'photo-probe-1.jpg', 'image/jpeg', 1000, repeat('a', 64), {{x_owner_user}})
INSERT INTO public.planner_my_modules (user_id, id, company_id, payload) VALUES ({{x_owner_user}}, 'my-probe01', {{company_x}}, '{"libId":"LB-D2-900","W":900}'::jsonb)

checks.name: 읽기 — 서버만 (익명 · 구성원 deny)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.planner_drafts where company_id = {{company_x}}

checks.name: 사진 · 내 모듈 읽기 — 서버만
checks.sql: select (select count(*) from public.planner_draft_photos) + (select count(*) from public.planner_my_modules where user_id = {{x_owner_user}})

checks.name: 구성원은 쓰지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_drafts (company_id, id, model) values ({{company_x}}, 'd-probe-b', '{}'::jsonb)

checks.name: 서버 — 새 설계 (같은 id 도 다른 업체면 따로)
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_drafts (company_id, id, model) values ({{company_y}}, 'd-probe-a', '{}'::jsonb)

checks.name: 설계 id 모양이 아니면 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_drafts (company_id, id, model) values ({{company_x}}, '../x', '{}'::jsonb)

checks.name: 고치기 — 내용이 바뀌면 rev 하나, 고친 때가 찍힌다
checks.sql: update public.planner_drafts set model = '{"walls":[1]}'::jsonb, rev = 2, updated_at = '2000-01-01' where company_id = {{company_x}} and id = 'd-probe-a'; select rev || '/' || (updated_at > '2001-01-01') from public.planner_drafts where company_id = {{company_x}} and id = 'd-probe-a'

checks.name: rev 를 건너뛰면 거절
checks.sql: update public.planner_drafts set model = '{"walls":[2]}'::jsonb, rev = 3 where company_id = {{company_x}} and id = 'd-probe-a'

checks.name: 내용이 그대로면 rev 도 그대로
checks.sql: update public.planner_drafts set rev = 2 where company_id = {{company_x}} and id = 'd-probe-a'

checks.name: 만든 사람은 바꿀 수 없다
checks.sql: update public.planner_drafts set created_by = {{y_owner_user}} where company_id = {{company_x}} and id = 'd-probe-a'

checks.name: 버린 설계는 바뀌지 않는다
checks.sql: update public.planner_drafts set model = '{"walls":[3]}'::jsonb, rev = 2 where company_id = {{company_x}} and id = 'd-probe-gone'

checks.name: 설계 지우기는 서버도 못 한다
checks.sql: delete from public.planner_drafts where company_id = {{company_x}} and id = 'd-probe-a'

checks.name: 사진은 같은 업체 설계에만
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_draft_photos (company_id, draft_id, file, mime, bytes, sha256) values ({{company_y}}, 'd-probe-gone', 'photo-probe-2.jpg', 'image/jpeg', 1000, repeat('b', 64))

checks.name: 사진 내용은 바꿀 수 없다
checks.sql: update public.planner_draft_photos set bytes = 2000 where company_id = {{company_x}} and file = 'photo-probe-1.jpg'

checks.name: 사진 지우기 — 표시만 한 번
checks.sql: update public.planner_draft_photos set deleted_at = now() where company_id = {{company_x}} and file = 'photo-probe-1.jpg'; select (deleted_at is not null)::text from public.planner_draft_photos where company_id = {{company_x}} and file = 'photo-probe-1.jpg'

checks.name: 사진 줄 지우기는 서버도 못 한다
내 모듈 — 고치기는 못 하고 지우기는 된다
checks.sql: update public.planner_my_modules set payload = '{}'::jsonb where user_id = {{x_owner_user}}

checks.name: 내 모듈 지우기
checks.sql: delete from public.planner_my_modules where user_id = {{x_owner_user}} and id = 'my-probe01'

checks.name: 사진 버킷 — 비공개 · 15MB · JPEG · PNG · WEBP
checks.sql: select public || '/' || file_size_limit || '/' || array_to_string(allowed_mime_types, ',') from storage.buckets where id = 'planner-photos'
